name: pro-quality
description: Quality gate skills: requesting + receiving code review, verification-before-completion, user-validation. Documentation subagents (technical-writer, documentation-engineer, api-documenter) with /document and /api-docs. Stop hook suggests /validate after repo changes; an API-contract-drift hook. A floor guard warns on git push and gh pr create when a diff lowers the bar; /constraints writes a repo's CONSTRAINTS.md. A code-reviewer agent (Opus, read-only) reviews with fresh context from a four-field handoff.
